safe.en: I'm Alastair Budge, you stay safe, and I'll catch you in the next episode.
safe.zh: 我是 Alastair Budge，祝大家安好，我们下期节目再见。

safe.en: Plants had been scheduled for closure. Engineers had already begun the paperwork for decommissioning , which is the long, careful process of shutting a reactor down for good and making it safe.
safe.zh: 各核电站已被安排关闭。工程师们已经开始为退役办理手续，退役是一个漫长而谨慎的过程，旨在彻底关闭反应堆并确保其安全。

save.en: They're where your Netflix movies are stored, your Spotify playlists are saved, and where the tens of billions of hours of YouTube videos are held.
save.zh: 它们是存储你的 Netflix 电影、保存你的 Spotify 播放列表，以及存放数百亿小时 YouTube 视频的地方。

safely.en: This one ran safely for decades, and only closed in 2019, for ordinary financial reasons.
safely.zh: 这一座反应堆安全运行了数十年，直到2019年才出于普通的财务原因关闭。

safely.en: It is in the final stages of opening a nuclear storage site deep underground that will be able to safely store nuclear waste for 100,000 years.
safely.zh: 它在地下深处建造的核废料处置库已处于最后开放阶段，该处置库将能安全储存核废料长达10万年。

sake.en: Let's say, for the sake of example, a nuclear power plant takes 10 years to build, you will pay €1 billion in interest payments on a €1 billion loan.
sake.zh: 假设建一座核电站需要10年时间，那么在10亿欧元的贷款上，你光是利息就要支付10亿欧元。

safety.en: Meat was cooked until it was extremely well done , partly due to misunderstandings about food safety.
safety.zh: 肉被煮到非常熟的程度，部分原因是由于对食物安全的误解。

safety.en: This is why fission plants need so many layers of safety systems, and those layers are a big part of what makes them so expensive to build.
safety.zh: 这就是为什么裂变电站需要层层安全系统，而这些安全系统正是造价如此高昂的主要原因。

saw.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
saw.zh: 战后几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食餐、微波炉食品。

sauce.en: Spices appear in traditional British recipes for meat, desserts, sauces, baked goods, and drinks.
sauce.zh: 香料出现在肉类、甜点、酱汁、烘焙食品和饮料的传统英国食谱中。

sauce.en: British curry houses develop their own styles of curries and their own sauces and breads that aren’t really found in South Asia.
sauce.zh: 英国的咖喱屋开发了他们自己风格的咖喱以及在南亚并不常见的自己的酱汁和面包。

sausage.en: Black pudding is a traditional spiced blood sausage and part of a traditional breakfast.
sausage.zh: 黑布丁是一种传统的加香料的血肠，也是传统早餐的一部分。

sausage.en: For breakfast, you can try full English breakfasts: eggs, bacon, sausages, beans, mushrooms, tomatoes, and toast, sometimes black pudding as well.
sausage.zh: 早餐方面，你可以尝试英式全套早餐：鸡蛋、培根、香肠、焗豆、蘑菇、西红柿和吐司，有时还有黑布丁。

salt.en: The most obvious choice is fish and chips: fried fish, usually cod or haddock, with thick-cut chips served with salt and vinegar.
salt.zh: 最明显的选择是炸鱼薯条：炸鱼，通常是鳕鱼或黑线鳕，配上厚切薯条，佐以盐和醋。

salt.en: A roast joint of beef would usually just be seasoned with salt and pepper, some herbs as well, and then served with vegetables and gravy and perhaps horseradish or mustard.
salt.zh: 一块烤牛肉通常只用盐和胡椒、一些草本植物调味，然后配上蔬菜、肉汁，也许还有辣根或芥末。

sandwich.en: Don’t just go to the supermarket and buy a sandwich and complain that British food is bad.
sandwich.zh: 不要只去超市买个三明治然后抱怨英国食物不好。
